content.title: Here's a list of notable runners in the 2026 Boston Marathon
content.text: The 130th running of the Boston Marathon will be held on April 20, with runners from 137 countries descending on the city for the race. NBC Universal, Inc. Our own Matt Prichard and Malcolm Johnson sat down to discuss how they’ve been getting ready to run in the Boston Marathon and the charities they’re doing it for. Marathon Monday is approaching, when thousands of runners from around the world will make the 26.2-mile journey from Hopkinton to Boylston Street in the world's oldest annual marathon road race. The 2026 Boston Marathon is set for April 20, with more than 34,000 participants registered. This is the 130th running of the race. Here's everything you need to know. There are some recognizable names among the thousands of runners competing in the 2026 Boston Marathon. Reigning open division champions Sharon Lokedi and John Korir from Kenya will return to defend their titles this year, as will wheelchair division champion Marcel Hug of Switzerland. Defending wheelchair division champion Susannah Scaroni of the U.S. was originally scheduled to compete but has since withdrawn from the field. American record holders and 2024 Olympians Emily Sisson and Conner Mantz will each enter as U.S. favorites. The full list of runners in the professional men and women's divisions can be seen here. Outside of the professional division, there are some notable celebrity runners, including: Bryan Arenales, 2025 Love Island USA winner Amby Burfoot, 1968 Boston Marathon champion Zdeno Chara, former Boston Bruins captain Chelsea Clinton, author and advocate Jeff DaRosa, member of the Dropkick Murphys Laura Green, running comedian Chris Herren, former Boston Celtics player Kristine Lilly, former Team USA soccer player Des Linden, 2018 Boston Marathon champion Suni Williams, astronaut There are also some NBC Boston Stations employees who are running: NBC Sports Boston's Drew Carter is running to support the Martin Richard Foundation NBC10 Boston/NBC Sports Boston/Telemundo Nueva Inglaterra Vice President of Partnerships Aaron Thomas is running for Golf Fights Cancer More on the Boston Marathon Hatmeo | A Gift That Honors 250 Years of American PrideUndoDonald TrumpHow much is Trump profiting off the presidency?
